The '''Minister of Commerce''' served the government of [[Garos IV]]. [[Magir Paca]] worked as an [[Assistant Minister of Commerce|assistant]] to the Minister prior to being outed as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garos underground]].
